description.value: BiblioCafe is a University of Victoria Food Services café tucked into the ground floor of the William C. Mearns Centre for Learning (McPherson Library) on the UVic campus. It offers specialty coffees and teas alongside a selection of grab-and-go items including sushi, sandwiches, wraps, salads, and freshly baked pastries and sweets. The UVic campus is well connected to Victoria's cycling network, making this a convenient mid-ride refuelling stop for cyclists exploring the Gordon Head area.
